predecessors.text: Derbent, the Caspian Gates city, an Abbasid frontier post under Arminiya

successors.name: Shirvan (Shirvanshahs)
successors.text: Derbent, absorbed into the Shirvanshah state after 1225

rulers.name: Mansur II b. Abd al-Malik II
rulers.title: emir

ledger.x: 869: the emirate of Derbent is formed.
1075: Fariburz I of Shirvan annexes Derbent.

c. 1130: Derbent is back under its own emirs. The page does not date the restoration after 1075: it says Seljuk intervention led to the Aghlabid line (Aghlab b. Ali appointed by Savtegin) and lists a later dynasty known to Abu Hamid al-Gharnati in the period c. 1130-1150; the year is a bridge.

c. 1225: the emirate ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: c. 1173 or c. 1225'; Rashid b. Farrukhzad was the last emir (c. 1222-c. 1225) and 'The emirate was again absorbed into Shirvanshah state after 1225'. The Shirvan dossier dates the Shirvanshah take-over c. 1201 from its own page.

wars.name: Khazar raid on Derbent
wars.outcome: 'In 901 AD (288 AH), the Emirate faced a large-scale Khazar raid.'

wars.name: Fariburz I's annexation of Derbent
wars.outcome: Fariburz I of Shirvan annexed Derbent in 1075 and the Hashimid dynasty fell.
